c3.note: permuted: the n_tok = 40 cells of frame 2 of the feature tensor [B, F, n_tok, d_feat] (one fixed random permutation, same for every window), either on the features (the adapter is per token, so this permutes the tokens before the position term) or on the adapt tensor after _encode (adapter + self.pos). self.pos enters in V8FMini._encode: adapt = adapter(feats) + pos[None, None]; a sum is permutation invariant, so the MEAN state cannot see the permutation on either path; the grid state concatenates per cell and does.
